easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Essence Flux.
description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and putting Essence Flux into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Essence Flux to your hand.
Repeat.
